blurb: Boating with Sandbar Trips in Key West is fun in the sun for the whole family. Experience this Key West Boat Tour of backcountry paradise and beach lounge, birdwatch, dolphin watch, enjoy a Sunset cruise or a Sunrise cruise. Sandbar charter with us and create memories and photos that last a lifetime. Deck-boat charter comes with a captain/guide for each trip who knows the local waters. Boat is dog friendly.
